'''Lincoln Torrey''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Bravo 21 from Richmond, Va. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. At DecipherCon 1999 he finished 26th in [[Young Jedi]] Qualifier 4 (Constructed).<ref name="dc99yj04_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ04_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier 4 (Constructed)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108191000/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ04_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
